description: Sloppy volunteer-day notice with a named volunteer's quote that itself contains a stock word: the framing, staged reveals and chatbot closer go, while the stated comparison (340 saplings in 6 hours against 215 in 9, 125 more trees in 3 fewer hours), the negations, the hedge and the quote word for word survive.
prompt: This notice for our orchard volunteer day sounds machine-written. Remove the AI-sounding phrasing from notice.md and save the edited version to out/notice.md.

files.notice.md:
In today's fast-paced world, finding time for nature matters more than ever. We are thrilled to announce the Pennywhistle Lane Community Orchard autumn planting day on Saturday 7 November. This event marks a pivotal moment for our neighbourhood, underscoring our commitment to green space.

Here's the thing: last year was big. The best part? Volunteers planted 340 saplings in 6 hours, up from 215 saplings in 9 hours in 2025, which is 125 more trees in 3 fewer hours. Spades and gloves are supplied, but boots are not, and we will not be able to offer parking on the lane. Rain may move the day to Sunday 8 November, though we will only decide by 7 pm on Friday.

"I'm thrilled, honestly. I only came for the cake, and I planted forty trees," said volunteer Marguerite Oduya. We hope this helps you plan your weekend, and let us know in the comments what you think!

checks.note: 'more than ever' belongs to the era-opener that goes; every figure, hedge and 'only' stays. Negations are not counted by word: an edit may say 'bring your own boots' or 'there won't be parking' for 'boots are not (supplied)' and 'we will not be able to offer parking' (runs baseline r2, competitor-humanizer r2/r3); the two negated facts are checked by meaning in the next two checks
boots are not supplied: stated as a negation or as an instruction to bring your own, in any wording
no parking on the lane: 'no parking', 'there won't be parking' and 'we cannot offer parking' all count

values: I'm thrilled, honestly. I only came for the cake, and I planted forty trees
checks.note: a quotation is the volunteer's own words; the stock word inside it is hers to keep, so the edit leaves the quote word for word (straight or curly quote marks both count)
the notice itself states the difference (125 more trees); the edit keeps it
a notice for volunteers is published as it stands; any question goes in the reply
